about.description: AXON is a single-stock perpetual listed on Bitget, tracking Axon Enterprise, Inc., margined and cash-settled in USDT. Traders get synthetic price exposure only — no ownership, dividend or voting rights in the underlying. Bitget prices this market off the Ondo tokenized stock for Axon Enterprise, Inc., a tokenized representation of the listed shares rather than the shares themselves. Funding settles every 8h. Up to 20× leverage. Margin is custodied by the exchange rather than self custodied, and access requires exchange onboarding with identity verification.
